item: KPI figures at 36–48px bold in the brand colour
Gradient area chart, smoothed spline, a dot on every point; a hue per bar
Zebra table, uppercase tracked headers, checkbox, avatar, chip and kebab on every row
Left-aligned proportional digits
The accent on every button, tab and link
Sound with no off switch
Perpetual loops (pulse, float, shimmer, typewriter) on components at rest
Pastel blobs, rounded-everything and "bold colors" because the brief said "fun"
Streaks, badges and points on a tool nobody asked to gamify
Fake waiting jokes; a delay staged before a flourish
Actions are `<button>`, navigation is `<a>`/`<Link>`; no click handlers on `div`/`span`. `lint: div-onclick`
Icon-only buttons have an accessible name. `lint: icon-button-label`
Sticky headers and overlays never cover the focused element; dialogs trap and return focus; `overscroll-behavior: contain` in sheets and drawers.
No `transition: all`; animate transform/opacity/colour only. `lint: transition-all`
Labels on every form control; errors inline, specific, with the fix; first error focused on submit.
Buttons name their action; the same verb carries through the flow.
No console errors; the page renders (an empty `#root` passes every code check and is still a failure).
Loads at the top (`scrollY === 0`); no horizontal overflow at 375px and 1280px (`scrollWidth <= innerWidth`).
Dark mode designed, not inverted: `color-scheme: dark`, tokens only, no manual `dark:` colour overrides. `lint: dark-override`
Browser surfaces themed: text selection, caret, scrollbars, underline offset, focus ring colour.
Dark mode nobody asked for; dark ground with muted grey body text
Glass and backdrop blur as decoration
Monotonous spacing; heading closer to the block above than its own content
Fake window chrome (macOS traffic lights) as the hero
Modal as the first thought
"X theater" framing
Cyan or neon accents on a dark ground; several neon accents with no dominant one
Every button styled as primary
Emoji as icons or bullets; Unicode glyphs as an icon system
The worn Lucide set: `Sparkles` for AI, `Zap`, `Rocket`, `Shield`, `ArrowRight`
